You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Kite on the Wind",
  "slug": "kite-on-the-wind",
  "lang": "en",
  "gameType": "arcade-run",
  "loop": "Tap to lift the paper kite, dodging chimneys and collecting ribbons as the wind speeds up. Hitting a chimney ends the run; your ribbon count is the score.",
  "input": "tap-anywhere",
  "style": "paper-cut"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `arcade-run`

# Arcade run

The world scrolls on its own, the player dodges and gathers, and one mistake ends the run.

## Contract row

| field                | value         |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| score                | `required`    |
| level                | `forbidden`   |
| end                  | `required`    |
| end reasons          | `lose`        |
| reset                | `soft`        |
| idle death gate      | `min-seconds` |
| idle motion required | `yes`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above at least once: `score` as points change and `end` when the run is over. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden`. A run has no levels, so ramp difficulty with speed instead. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- The only allowed `end` reason is `lose`. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## Fairness

A player who does nothing must survive for a few seconds after `start`. Spawn the first hazard well ahead of the player and keep the opening lane clear.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let last = 0,
  running = false,
  paused = false,
  score = 0;
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
  last = now;
  if (running && !paused) {
    advance(dt);
    collide();
  }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
function crash() {
  running = false;
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
}
```

Keep something moving on screen while idle (clouds, a pulsing prompt) so the run never looks frozen.

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `paper-cut`

# Paper cut

Everything looks cut from coloured card and stacked in layers.

## Palette

| role       | colour    |
| ---------- | --------- |
| background | `#f4ecd8` |
| layer      | `#e07a5f` |
| accent     | `#3d405b` |
| highlight  | `#81b29a` |

## Primitives

- Filled paths with slightly irregular edges: jitter each vertex by one or two pixels, seeded once so it does not flicker.
- One soft shadow per layer: `shadowBlur` around 6 and a small downward offset.
- Rounded rectangles and circles for pieces; stacked copies offset by a few pixels suggest depth.
- Text in a heavy system sans-serif, drawn on a card-shaped plate.

## Avoid

- Gradients, glows and outlines thicker than two pixels.
- Pure black; use the accent colour for the darkest tone.
- Photographic textures or anything loaded from a file.

### Card `tap-anywhere`

# Tap anywhere

The whole screen is the button. Best for jumps, flaps and single choices.

- Register pointer input on the canvas: `canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onTap)`. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Call `event.preventDefault()` and set `touch-action: none` on the canvas so the page does not scroll or zoom.
- The first tap after `boot` starts play and sends `start`; later taps perform the action.
- Ignore taps while paused.

```js
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  act();
});
```

Show a short pulsing hint ("Tap to begin") until the first tap.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
I'll create the complete game page now.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Kite on the Wind</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: #f4ecd8;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  let DPR = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
  let W = 0, H = 0;

  function resize(){
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    DPR = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR);
    canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // Palette
  const COLORS = {
    bg: '#f4ecd8',
    layer: '#e07a5f',
    accent: '#3d405b',
    highlight: '#81b29a'
  };

  // Seeded jitter helper for paper-cut edges
  function mulberry32(a){
    return function(){
      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }
  const jitterRand = mulberry32(12345);
  function jitteredPoints(points, amt){
    return points.map(p => [
      p[0] + (jitterRand() - 0.5) * amt * 2,
      p[1] + (jitterRand() - 0.5) * amt * 2
    ]);
  }

  function drawPaperShape(pointsArr, fillColor, shadow){
    ctx.save();
    if (shadow !== false){
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(61,64,91,0.35)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
      ctx.shadowOffsetX = 0;
      ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = fillColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pointsArr[0][0], pointsArr[0][1]);
    for (let i=1;i<pointsArr.length;i++){
      ctx.lineTo(pointsArr[i][0], pointsArr[i][1]);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function roundRectPath(x,y,w,h,r){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w, y, x+w, y+h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w, y+h, x, y+h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y+h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x+w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawRoundedPlate(x,y,w,h,r,color){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(61,64,91,0.35)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetX = 0;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    roundRectPath(x,y,w,h,r);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Game state
  let last = 0;
  let running = false;
  let paused = false;
  let started = false; // whether boot happened
  let score = 0;
  let ribbons = 0;
  let time = 0;
  let elapsedSinceStart = 0;

  // Kite (player)
  let kiteX, kiteY, kiteVY;
  const kiteSize = 28;
  const gravity = 520;
  const liftVY = -230;

  // World
  let worldSpeed = 160;
  const speedRamp = 3.2; // px/s^2 growth
  let chimneys = [];
  let ribbonsList = [];
  let clouds = [];
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let ribbonSpawnTimer = 0;

  const GROUND_Y_FRAC = 0.86;

  function resetWorld(){
    kiteX = () => W * 0.28;
    kiteY = H * 0.45;
    kiteVY = 0;
    score = 0;
    ribbons = 0;
    time = 0;
    elapsedSinceStart = 0;
    worldSpeed = 160;
    chimneys = [];
    ribbonsList = [];
    spawnTimer = 2.2; // fairness: first hazard well ahead
    ribbonSpawnTimer = 1.2;
  }

  function initClouds(){
    clouds = [];
    for (let i=0;i<6;i++){
      clouds.push({
        x: Math.random()*1200,
        y: 40 + Math.random()*140,
        s: 0.6 + Math.random()*0.8,
        speed: 12 + Math.random()*18
      });
    }
  }

  let kiteYVal = 0;
  function fullReset(){
    kiteYVal = H*0.45;
    kiteVY = 0;
    score = 0;
    ribbons = 0;
    time = 0;
    elapsedSinceStart = 0;
    worldSpeed = 160;
    chimneys = [];
    ribbonsList = [];
    spawnTimer = 2.2;
    ribbonSpawnTimer = 1.2;
    running = false;
    paused = false;
  }

  fullReset();
  initClouds();

  function backToTitle(){
    fullReset();
  }

  function spawnChimney(){
    const groundY = H * GROUND_Y_FRAC;
    const gapH = Math.max(140, 260 - elapsedSinceStart*2);
    const gapY = 60 + Math.random() * (groundY - gapH - 120);
    chimneys.push({
      x: W + 60,
      w: 54,
      gapY: gapY,
      gapH: gapH,
      passed: false
    });
  }

  function spawnRibbon(){
    const groundY = H * GROUND_Y_FRAC;
    ribbonsList.push({
      x: W + 40,
      y: 60 + Math.random() * (groundY - 160),
      r: 14,
      taken: false
    });
  }

  function act(){
    kiteVY = liftVY;
  }

  function advance(dt){
    elapsedSinceStart += dt;
    time += dt;
    worldSpeed += speedRamp * dt;

    // clouds always drift for idle liveliness
    for (const c of clouds){
      c.x -= c.speed * dt;
      if (c.x < -120) c.x = W + 120 + Math.random()*80;
    }

    // kite physics
    kiteVY += gravity * dt;
    kiteYVal += kiteVY * dt;
    const groundY = H * GROUND_Y_FRAC;
    if (kiteYVal < 10) { kiteYVal = 10; kiteVY = 0; }
    if (kiteYVal > groundY - kiteSize) {
      kiteYVal = groundY - kiteSize;
      crash();
      return;
    }

    // spawn hazards
    spawnTimer -= dt;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0){
      spawnChimney();
      spawnTimer = Math.max(1.1, 2.3 - elapsedSinceStart*0.03);
    }
    ribbonSpawnTimer -= dt;
    if (ribbonSpawnTimer <= 0){
      spawnRibbon();
      ribbonSpawnTimer = 1.4 + Math.random()*1.2;
    }

    // move chimneys
    for (const c of chimneys){
      c.x -= worldSpeed * dt;
      if (!c.passed && c.x + c.w < W*0.28){
        c.passed = true;
        score += 1;
        CARTRIDGE.send('score', { value: score + ribbons });
      }
    }
    chimneys = chimneys.filter(c => c.x + c.w > -20);

    // move ribbons
    for (const r of ribbonsList){
      r.x -= worldSpeed * dt;
    }
    ribbonsList = ribbonsList.filter(r => r.x > -40 && !r.taken);
  }

  function collide(){
    const px = W*0.28;
    const py = kiteYVal;
    const pr = kiteSize*0.5;

    // chimneys
    for (const c of chimneys){
      if (px + pr > c.x && px - pr < c.x + c.w){
        if (py - pr < c.gapY || py + pr > c.gapY + c.gapH){
          crash();
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    // ribbons
    for (const r of ribbonsList){
      if (r.taken) continue;
      const dx = px - r.x;
      const dy = py - r.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
      if (dist < pr + r.r){
        r.taken = true;
        ribbons += 1;
        CARTRIDGE.send('score', { value: score + ribbons });
      }
    }
  }

  function crash(){
    if (!running) return;
    running = false;
    CARTRIDGE.send('end', { reason: 'lose', value: score + ribbons });
  }

  // Drawing
  function drawBackground(){
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    // clouds - simple paper-cut puffs
    for (const c of clouds){
      const pts = jitteredPoints([
        [c.x-30*c.s, c.y],
        [c.x-10*c.s, c.y-18*c.s],
        [c.x+15*c.s, c.y-20*c.s],
        [c.x+35*c.s, c.y-6*c.s],
        [c.x+30*c.s, c.y+14*c.s],
        [c.x-20*c.s, c.y+14*c.s]
      ], 1.5);
      drawPaperShape(pts, '#ffffff', false);
    }

    // ground
    const groundY = H * GROUND_Y_FRAC;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(61,64,91,0.3)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = -3;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.highlight;
    ctx.fillRect(0, groundY + kiteSize, W, H - groundY - kiteSize);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawChimney(c){
    const groundY = H * GROUND_Y_FRAC;
    // top part
    const topPts = jitteredPoints([
      [c.x, 0],
      [c.x + c.w, 0],
      [c.x + c.w, c.gapY],
      [c.x, c.gapY]
    ], 1.5);
    drawPaperShape(topPts, COLORS.layer);

    // bottom part
    const botPts = jitteredPoints([
      [c.x, c.gapY + c.gapH],
      [c.x + c.w, c.gapY + c.gapH],
      [c.x + c.w, groundY + kiteSize],
      [c.x, groundY + kiteSize]
    ], 1.5);
    drawPaperShape(botPts, COLORS.layer);

    // accent stripe caps
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
    ctx.fillRect(c.x-3, Math.max(0,c.gapY-10), c.w+6, 10);
    ctx.fillRect(c.x-3, c.gapY + c.gapH, c.w+6, 10);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawRibbon(r){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(r.x, r.y);
    ctx.rotate(Math.sin(time*3 + r.x*0.05) * 0.3);
    const pts = jitteredPoints([
      [-14,-4],[-4,-12],[6,-10],[14,0],[6,10],[-4,12],[-14,4]
    ], 1.2);
    drawPaperShape(pts, COLORS.accent);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawKite(){
    const x = W*0.28;
    const y = kiteYVal;
    const s = kiteSize;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x,y);
    const tilt = Math.max(-0.4, Math.min(0.4, -kiteVY/600));
    ctx.rotate(tilt);

    // tail
    ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.accent;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s*0.2, s*0.6);
    for (let i=1;i<=4;i++){
      ctx.lineTo(-s*0.2 - i*6, s*0.6 + Math.sin(time*6+i)*5 + i*4);
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // kite body (diamond)
    const pts = jitteredPoints([
      [0,-s],
      [s*0.8,0],
      [0,s],
      [-s*0.8,0]
    ], 1.5);
    drawPaperShape(pts, COLORS.highlight);

    // inner accent diamond
    const innerPts = jitteredPoints([
      [0,-s*0.45],
      [s*0.35,0],
      [0,s*0.45],
      [-s*0.35,0]
    ], 1);
    drawPaperShape(innerPts, COLORS.layer, false);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    const total = score + ribbons;
    const text = 'Ribbons: ' + total;
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px sans-serif';
    const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width;
    drawRoundedPlate(14, 14, tw + 28, 38, 10, '#ffffff');
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
    ctx.fillText(text, 28, 40);
  }

  function drawTitleScreen(){
    drawBackground();
    drawKite();

    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(time*3);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7 + pulse*0.3;
    const text = 'Tap to begin';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px sans-serif';
    const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width;
    drawRoundedPlate(W/2 - tw/2 - 20, H*0.3 - 30, tw+40, 56, 14, '#ffffff');
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(text, W/2 - tw/2, H*0.3 + 6);
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.font = 'bold 22px sans-serif';
    const t2 = 'Kite on the Wind';
    const tw2 = ctx.measureText(t2).width;
    drawRoundedPlate(W/2 - tw2/2 - 16, H*0.15 - 26, tw2+32, 46, 12, '#ffffff');
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.layer;
    ctx.fillText(t2, W/2 - tw2/2, H*0.15 + 4);
  }

  function drawGameOverOverlay(){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(244,236,216,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px sans-serif';
    const t = 'Run Over';
    const tw = ctx.measureText(t).width;
    drawRoundedPlate(W/2 - tw/2 - 20, H*0.35 - 34, tw+40, 60, 14, '#ffffff');
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
    ctx.fillText(t, W/2 - tw/2, H*0.35 + 6);

    const s2 = 'Ribbons: ' + (score+ribbons);
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px sans-serif';
    const tw2 = ctx.measureText(s2).width;
    drawRoundedPlate(W/2 - tw2/2 - 16, H*0.35 + 40, tw2+32, 44, 12, '#ffffff');
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.layer;
    ctx.fillText(s2, W/2 - tw2/2, H*0.35 + 70);

    ctx.font = 'bold 18px sans-serif';
    const s3 = 'Tap to try again';
    const tw3 = ctx.measureText(s3).width;
    drawRoundedPlate(W/2 - tw3/2 - 14, H*0.35 + 100, tw3+28, 38, 10, '#ffffff');
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
    ctx.fillText(s3, W/2 - tw3/2, H*0.35 + 126);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  let awaitingRestart = false;

  function draw(){
    if (!running && !awaitingRestart){
      drawTitleScreen();
      return;
    }
    drawBackground();
    for (const c of chimneys) drawChimney(c);
    for (const r of ribbonsList) if (!r.taken) drawRibbon(r);
    drawKite();
    drawHUD();

    if (paused){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(61,64,91,0.4)';
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.font = 'bold 26px sans-serif';
      const t = 'Paused';
      const tw = ctx.measureText(t).width;
      drawRoundedPlate(W/2-tw/2-18, H/2-30, tw+36, 50, 12, '#ffffff');
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
      ctx.fillText(t, W/2-tw/2, H/2+2);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    if (awaitingRestart && !running){
      drawGameOverOverlay();
    }
  }

  function frame(now){
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
    last = now;
    if (running && !paused){
      advance(dt);
      collide();
      if (!running){
        awaitingRestart = true;
      }
    } else if (!running){
      time += dt;
      for (const c of clouds){
        c.x -= c.speed * dt * 0.5;
        if (c.x < -120) c.x = W + 120 + Math.random()*80;
      }
    }
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  canvas.style.touchAction = 'none';
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (paused) return;
    if (!running && awaitingRestart){
      fullReset();
      awaitingRestart = false;
      running = true;
      CARTRIDGE.send('start');
      return;
    }
    if (!running){
      running = true;
      CARTRIDGE.send('start');
      return;
    }
    act();
  });

  window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
    const data = event.data;
    if (!data || data.source !== 'cartridge-host') return;
    if (data.type === 'pause') paused = true;
    if (data.type === 'resume') paused = false;
    if (data.type === 'reset'){
      awaitingRestart = false;
      backToTitle();
    }
  });

  requestAnimationFrame((t) => {
    last = t;
    draw();
    CARTRIDGE.send('boot', { title: 'Kite on the Wind', gameType: 'arcade-run', lang: 'en' });
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
